question:
**Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.**

Keen
solution:
The correct answer is** "Insensitive". **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word **Keen **typically means having or showing eagerness or enthusiasm; in some contexts, it can also mean sharp or penetrating, in terms of senses like sight or smell. **(उत्सुक, तीव्र)**

 
 
• **Example: **She has a **keen **interest in learning about different cultures.
 
 
 
• The correct antonym **Insensitive **means not feeling or showing sympathy for other people's feelings, or not noticing the effects that an action has. **(असंवेदनशील)**
 
 
• **Example: **His **insensitive **remarks about her appearance made her upset.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 1". **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Accurate **means correct in all details; exact. **(सटीक)**

 
 
• **Example: **The journalist needed to ensure that her report was **accurate.**
 
 
 
• **Perceptive **means having or showing sensitive insight or understanding of things. **(परिप्रेक्षी)**
 
 
• **Example: **He is very **perceptive **about the feelings of others, often noticing things that others overlook.
 
 
 
• **Subtle **means delicate or precise as to be difficult to analyze or describe; not obvious. **(सूक्ष्म)**
 
 
• **Example: **The film's plot was complex with many subtle twists that were easy to miss.
